title: Breezeway
meta_description: Private Pool, Gulf & State Park Views- Breezeway by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Breezeway by Royal Destinations Location: Grayton Beach Address: 112 Savelle Drive Details: Breezeway is a spacious coastal retreat located in Gulf Trace, a private and highly sought-after Grayton Beach neighborhood surrounded by Grayton Beach State Park and the Gulf of Mexico. Offering approximately 2,882 square feet of interior living space, this inviting home accommodates up to 12 guests with four bedrooms and four full baths. A vaulted living area, multiple outdoor decks, and a crow’s nest with beautiful Gulf views provide plenty of space to relax and enjoy the natural surroundings. Outside, guests can spend the day by the private pool or take an approximately three-minute stroll to one of the neighborhood’s private beach accesses. Surrounded by Grayton Beach State Park, Gulf Trace offers access to an exceptional stretch of undisturbed shoreline while remaining convenient to the shops, dining, and local character of Grayton Beach and neighboring Seaside. With its private pool, Gulf views, and peaceful setting, Breezeway provides an ideal home base for experiencing this special stretch of 30A. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Approximately 3-Minute Walk to Private Neighborhood Beach Access -Parking Spaces: (4) in Carport and Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8 -Coffee Maker Available: Hamilton Beach K-Cup + Drip Coffee Maker -Private Pool (Not Heated) -(2) Private Neighborhood Beach Accesses -Borders Grayton Beach State Park -Vaulted Living Area -Multiple Outdoor Decks -Crow’s Nest with Gulf Views -Outdoor Shower -Outdoor Gas Grill Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 4 Bedrooms / 4 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: (2) Queen Beds with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Detached Full Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Laundry Room -Access to Pool Area Second Floor: -Bedroom 3: (2) Queen Beds with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Bedroom 4 (Master): King Bed with Detached Full Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area -Covered Porch -Access to Crow’s Nest with Gulf Views Third Floor: -Bonus Living Area Please Note: *Golf carts and on-street parking are strictly prohibited within the Gulf Trace neighborhood. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
